name: UltraGauss Rendering
definition: A rendering method for 3D ultrasound volumes that treats the probe plane as a 3D intersection target rather than a 2D projection target, using 3D Mahalanobis distance to evaluate opacity and avoiding occlusion modeling.
summary: UltraGauss Rendering is a 3D ultrasound method that intersects 3D Gaussians with the probe plane using Mahalanobis distance to avoid occlusion modeling.
